plugin_paths.description: Paths to the bogofilter plugin (.so) to load. Usually only one.

bogofilter_config_path.description: Optional custom path to bogofilter configuration (e.g., ~/.bogofilter/config). If omitted, bogofilter uses its default config location.

spam_threshold.description: Spam score threshold (between 0.0 and 1.0). Messages scoring ≥ threshold are marked as spam. Standard bogofilter default: 0.5.

enable_learning.description: Whether to enable learning from spam/ham folders via Claws Mail menu. If false, manual learning via menus is disabled.
